design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE robust STAG/RHINOCEROS BEETLE-shaped Gu with TWO enormous PINCER MANDIBLES at head, body larger than adult palm canonical. Entire cuticle resembling GREY STONE, back NOT smooth, jagged rugged relief like a mountain cliff. Thick grounded beetle body, small neutral head under two strong curved opposing pincer jaws, six solid short beetle legs, green MOSS-like SPECKLED PATTERNS at limb JOINTS. Not an insect with a single rhinoceros horn or deer antlers, NOT literal mountain peaks towering on its back, not moss garden. Stone material looks alive: dense charcoal-grey mineral grain, naturally layered irregular ridges and small crevices, side light defines shell's rough unevenness; no gold, jade, crystal or smooth concrete sculpture. Green markings limited to joints as small organic mottling, no bushes/flowers growing out of body. Slight elevated oblique view shows grey cliff-like shell and pincers, legs fully clear. Subject standing on plain subdued dry grey clay soil with shallow low-contrast undulations, empty cool mist-soft background with no actual mountain landscape. Soft diffuse sidelight and credible heavy contact shadow, no glowing oath symbols, chains, writing, mountain deity or ritual setting. This beetle's own rough cliff back conveys mountain identity without scenery taking over.
